mainEntity.name: How much does AmigoHelp AI cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start free with 10 minutes, no card required. After that, choose pay-as-you-go minute packs: Starter ($15 / 120 min), Essential ($33.75 / 300 min), or Scale ($127.50 / 1,200 min). Or go unlimited with an optional monthly subscription.
Yes. Every new account gets 10 free minutes to try Amigo in a real or practice interview, with no credit card required.
No. Purchased minutes never expire. Unused minutes carry over indefinitely with no monthly reset.

mainEntity.name: Pay-as-you-go or Unlimited, which should I pick?

acceptedAnswer.text: For occasional interviews, a minute pack lets you pay only for what you use. For ongoing interviewing, the monthly Unlimited subscription gives unlimited session access. The two are billed and tracked independently.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods do you accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: Payments are processed securely via Stripe. All major credit and debit cards are accepted.
Unused minutes can be refunded within 30 days of purchase. Contact support@amigohelp.ai to request one.
